# Nuked OPL3 1.8

The YMF262 (OPL3) emulator by Nuke.YKT, from https://github.com/nukeykt/Nuked-OPL3
(files `opl3.c` and `opl3.h`, unchanged).  Licence: GNU LGPL 2.1 or later (see the file
headers); Terra Nova: Freefall as a whole is GPL-3.0.

Used by `port/audio/fmsynth.c` for the FM music (the sound of an OPL3 card such as the Sound
Blaster 16 or Pro 2).
